narrative: KVP36-2427C-0381 keeps derating in the afternoon heat. Got the OEM support line on the phone and they had me pull the logs off it and send them in. Case opened, no answer yet. Checked the filters, the intake screens and the plenum before I called them, all clear, and all six fans are turning. Cabinet temperature climbs through the afternoon and comes back down after sundown without anyone touching it. Nothing to reset and no fault stored.
